notes: NEW: Game profiles (was Game boost) - every game gets its own setup that switches on by itself when it starts and goes back when you quit: power plan, background apps calmed or closed, headset or speakers, brightness
Stretched resolution per game with the sizes pros use (CS2 1280x960...), at your screen's top refresh rate - V checks it on your screen first, so it can never leave you with a black screen
Pro settings in one key for CS2, Valorant and Fortnite - everything low for FPS, except what helps you see enemies. I shows the list, G again puts your own settings back
NEW: Autopilot (F1 > Autopilot) - weekly Purge, a restore point before big Windows updates, and a notice when a drive is almost full, your graphics driver is old or apps have updates
Apps + storage: uninstall Microsoft Store apps too, and updates now show a progress bar and a plain reason when one can't update
MahqLAB now says MAHQLAB in the big logo (Premium still puts your name there)
Fixed symbols that showed as ? on some screens, and the Discord button is easier to find
